grading_scale.A: historical source plus at least one clearly independent modern Rarámuri witness or multivariety elicitation, with strong semantic/formal alignment and no major unresolved mapping issue beyond normal reconstruction work
grading_scale.A-: independent historical-modern support is established, but a major phonological, semantic-granularity or mapping problem remains
grading_scale.B: strong historical-modern match but modern evidence independence is unresolved or concentrated in one lineage
grading_scale.B-: promising candidate with source-internal modern support but lacking independent modern replication
